content: 第一关（前）
Ruins of Chernobog 'District 14'
Sector Surface

speaker: Reunion Caster
content: What the hell?

raw: [name="Reunion Caster"]  Yeti Squad, why have you stopped firing? What are you waiting for?
speaker: Reunion Caster
content: Yeti Squad, why have you stopped firing? What are you waiting for?

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  ...Dig out those ruins, huh?
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: ...Dig out those ruins, huh?

raw: [name="Reunion Caster"]  Didn't you plant the Originium? Why not collapse the whole plate and wipe out Rhodes Island all at once?
speaker: Reunion Caster
content: Didn't you plant the Originium? Why not collapse the whole plate and wipe out Rhodes Island all at once?

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  Are you kidding? FrostNova is still down there!
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: Are you kidding? FrostNova is still down there!

raw: [name="Reunion Caster"]  Then we'll deal with Rhodes Island. You guys keep digging. We'll be right there.
speaker: Reunion Caster
content: Then we'll deal with Rhodes Island. You guys keep digging. We'll be right there.

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  Not on this block! The superstructure in this sector is completely shredded. An untrained team fighting here could induce a total collapse!
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: Not on this block! The superstructure in this sector is completely shredded. An untrained team fighting here could induce a total collapse!

raw: [name="Reunion Caster"]  Wiping out Rhodes Island is a top priority. You take care of it.
speaker: Reunion Caster
content: Wiping out Rhodes Island is a top priority. You take care of it.

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  I'm not gonna argue with you. We'll fight what we gotta fight. Who decided on this priority anyway?
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: I'm not gonna argue with you. We'll fight what we gotta fight. Who decided on this priority anyway?

raw: [name="Reunion Caster"]  It's obviously our most important strategic goal.
speaker: Reunion Caster
content: It's obviously our most important strategic goal.

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  Were you thinking about strategic goals when you vented your anger on the Ursus?
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: Were you thinking about strategic goals when you vented your anger on the Ursus?

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  We'll do what we can. Give us some space.
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: We'll do what we can. Give us some space.

raw: [name="Reunion Caster"]  Did you... communicate with Rhodes Island?
speaker: Reunion Caster
content: Did you... communicate with Rhodes Island?

speaker: Reunion Caster
content: You're betraying the Movement!

speaker: Blaze
content: (What's going on over there?)

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  (I think we have to fight.)
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: (I think we have to fight.)

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  If you think communication is tantamount to betrayal then that's your prerogative.
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: If you think communication is tantamount to betrayal then that's your prerogative.

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  With that kind of tactical thinking, it's no wonder you're getting led around by the nose.
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: With that kind of tactical thinking, it's no wonder you're getting led around by the nose.

raw: [name="Reunion Caster"]  ...Yetis! What are you up to?!
speaker: Reunion Caster
content: ...Yetis! What are you up to?!

raw: [name="Reunion Caster"]  We outnumber you a hundred times over, don't be stupid!
speaker: Reunion Caster
content: We outnumber you a hundred times over, don't be stupid!

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  ...Come on, we fought the Ursus Standing Army like a million times, who's getting excited over a big angry mob?
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: ...Come on, we fought the Ursus Standing Army like a million times, who's getting excited over a big angry mob?

speaker: Reunion Caster
content: Just you wait!

speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: (Static)

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  Hey, Rhodes Island. We might have to teach those unruly bastards a lesson.
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: Hey, Rhodes Island. We might have to teach those unruly bastards a lesson.

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  You should probably stay out of it. We don't want to be accused of collaborating with the enemy.
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: You should probably stay out of it. We don't want to be accused of collaborating with the enemy.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Huh? Collaborating? What are you talking about?
speaker: Blaze
content: Huh? Collaborating? What are you talking about?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Amiya, what happened in the ruins, and what's the official party line on it?
speaker: Blaze
content: Amiya, what happened in the ruins, and what's the official party line on it?

raw: [name="Amiya"]  ......Nothing happened. We were fighting Yeti Squad and no other Reunion units joined the battle.
speaker: Amiya
content: ......Nothing happened. We were fighting Yeti Squad and no other Reunion units joined the battle.

speaker: Blaze
content: Acting? I'm a phenomenal actress.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  What do you say we put on a show and then take care of these guys in the ensuing chaos?
speaker: Blaze
content: What do you say we put on a show and then take care of these guys in the ensuing chaos?

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  Sounds good to me. What does your captain think?
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: Sounds good to me. What does your captain think?

raw: [name="Amiya"]  Excuse me, sir. How should I call you?
speaker: Amiya
content: Excuse me, sir. How should I call you?

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  ...Um, well, you're a really cute girl, but I'm not sure I'm ready for anything like that...
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: ...Um, well, you're a really cute girl, but I'm not sure I'm ready for anything like that...

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member B"]  Ready for what? What are you thinking?!
speaker: Yeti Squad Member B
content: Ready for what? What are you thinking?!

raw: [name="Yeti Squad Member A"]  Oh, sorry. I'm just playing around. You can call me Yeti #1, I guess.
speaker: Yeti Squad Member A
content: Oh, sorry. I'm just playing around. You can call me Yeti #1, I guess.

raw: [name="Amiya"]  All right, Mr. Yeti #1... We've got lives to save, don't we?
speaker: Amiya
content: All right, Mr. Yeti #1... We've got lives to save, don't we?

raw: [name="Amiya"]  So let's subdue the Reunion units that could interfere with our rescue mission.
speaker: Amiya
content: So let's subdue the Reunion units that could interfere with our rescue mission.

raw: [name="Mr. Yeti #1"]  Yeah. I'm plenty motivated now.
speaker: Mr. Yeti #1
content: Yeah. I'm plenty motivated now.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  ...And where exactly did you get that motivation?
speaker: Blaze
content: ...And where exactly did you get that motivation?
